title: A Begin answered with a lost-binding code after a host-side control reconnect is held for Resume
outcome: A Begin answered with a code that invalidates the routing token (engram_begin_replay.rs:64-71 at be2ed177: control_session_token_mismatch, control_connection_superseded and others) ends in an explicit interrupted hold. Check whether a transient host-side control-process restart or reconnect produces these codes for a begin that may not have been applied, and whether status can prove the grant's state, so recovery can run without Resume.
acceptance: A Begin answered with a lost-binding code after a host-side control reconnect is held for Resume is done
